title: switch
instructions: When you're checking one variable against many fixed values, a switch is cleaner than lots of else ifs.
switch (day) jumps to the case that matches.
Each case ends with break, which means 'stop here and leave the switch.' Forget break and it keeps running into the next case!
default runs if no case matched — like a final else.
task: Add the break for case 3 so the program prints only:  Wednesday
hint:
Add break; after the Wednesday print so it doesn't fall into default:

            break;
